options.veo_prompt:
The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter. [00:00-00:01] The burnt hand holds the price card, its fingers tightening. [00:01-00:03] The strip light sags to near darkness, buzzing. [00:03-00:04] The light snaps back to full and the hand is gone, the shelf and loaf exactly as before. One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera does not move.
Thanks.
